data.rationale: Owner approves the corrected revision 56 survivability bounds: zero listed conservation and rejected-action errors, zero Operations custody exposure, no separate runway requirement, at most 1,024 positions in the single Phase 1 payout, and a 100 USDG non-gas principal-loss cap for one separately authorized cooperative runner action bundle. Unresolved provider, authorizer, route-executor, bridge, and policy-wallet compromise exposures remain nonzero and unquantified. This approval authorizes no external action.
